questions.question_text: Write down a cube number between 10 and 100.
Work out (0.1)^4.
Alex goes to sleep at 2040 and wakes up the next morning at 0610. Work out the length of time, in hours and minutes, that Alex is asleep.
Work out \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ 3 \end{pmatrix} - \begin{pmatrix} -3 \\ 5 \end{pmatrix}.
F is the point (5, 7). The vector that maps F onto the point G is \begin{pmatrix} -1 \\ 3 \end{pmatrix}. Find the coordinates of G.
Work out \frac{3}{4} - \frac{1}{6}, giving your answer as a fraction in its lowest terms.
Divide $140 in the ratio 2 : 1 : 4.
The volume of a hemisphere with radius 3cm is k\pi\text{ cm}^3. Find the value of k.
Write 4^{-2} as a fraction.

A train is travelling at a speed of 30\text{ m/s}. The length of the train is 70\text{ m}. The train passes through a station of length 170\text{ m}. Find the time the train takes to pass completely through the station.
Triangle PQR is similar to triangle ABC. Work out the length of PR.
Two mathematically similar containers have capacities of 27 litres and 8 litres. The surface area of the smaller container is 1600\text{ cm}^2. Work out the surface area of the larger container.
Factorise 1 + x - y - xy.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle P onto triangle Q.
Stretch triangle T by a factor of 2 with invariant line x = 1.
Rationalise the denominator \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}.
In this calculation, the three numbers are written in standard form: (4 \times 10^p) \times (n \times 10^{p+2}) = 3.2 \times 10^t. n, p and t are integers. Find the value of n.
Find t in terms of p.
Simplify \frac{x-4}{x^2-16}.
The solutions to the equation x^2 + gx + h = 0 are \frac{1-\sqrt{17}}{2} and \frac{1+\sqrt{17}}{2}. Find the value of g and the value of h.
Write as a single fraction, giving your answer in its simplest form: 2 - \frac{3}{1+x}.
Find the value of \log 5 + \log 8 - 2\log 2.
